text:
```yaml
name: Codex Review Notify Code Owner

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]

permissions:
  pull-requests: write
  contents: read

jobs:
  verify_and_notify:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20
          cache: npm

      - name: Install Bun
        run: |
          curl -fsSL https://bun.sh/install | bash
          echo "$HOME/.bun/bin" >> $GITHUB_PATH

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: bun install

      - name: Verify skills
        run: bun run skills:verify

      - name: Auto-assign reviewers
        id: auto-assign
        uses: peter-evans/auto-assign@v1
        with:
          reviewers: true
          teams: true

      - name: Notify code owners
        uses: actions/github-script@v6
        with:
          script: |
            const reviewers = '${{ steps.auto-assign.outputs.reviewers }}';
            const teams = '${{ steps.auto-assign.outputs.teams }}';
            const reviewersList = reviewers ? reviewers.split(',').map(r => r.trim()).join(', ') : '';
            const teamsList = teams ? teams.split(',').map(t => t.trim()).join(', ') : '';
            const messageParts = [];
            if (reviewersList) messageParts.push(`Reviewers: ${reviewersList}`);
            if (teamsList) messageParts.push(`Teams: ${teamsList}`);
            const message = messageParts.length > 0 ? messageParts.join(' and ') : 'No reviewers or teams assigned.';
            await github.rest.issues.createComment({
              owner: context.repo.owner,
              repo: context.repo.repo,
              issue_number: context.issue.number,
              body: message
            });
```
